Ana: PR to align SDK snippets across py/ts/go for streaming retries pagination: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201
Ben: quick scan - TS uses `cursor` still; server expects `page_token`. I'll send a tiny patch.
Carmen: saw that. also py sync streaming example lacked context manager — can hang in some envs. will add sync+async examples.
Ben: pushed TS rename + note that `page_size` is advisory. commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/d1f2e3a
Carmen: sync snippet i validated:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream_response(model="redwood-stream-1") as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Ana: please add an async variant and a short note about prefix buffering for partial JSON.
Carmen: async variant added and a retry example with jitter.
docs-bot: CI OK (lint + smoke tests) for PR 4201. https://ci.internal/redwood/4201/9
Ben: Go snippet tweak: iterate over `resp.Chan` and handle ctx cancellation.
Ana: great — merging after a tiny line-length nitfix. thanks everyone :tada:
